command.vc-audio-distance.monitor_on: Players with the addon see the monitor, the radar and nearby players in the HUD. Saved.

command.vc-audio-distance.zone.need_play: Only a player in the game can do this.
command.vc-audio-distance.zone.set: Zone %s: %s = %s. Saved and sent to players with the addon.
command.vc-audio-distance.zone.unknown: There is no zone %s (/vcd zones lists them).

gui.vc-audio-distance.cancel.tooltip: Discard every change made since this screen was opened.
gui.vc-audio-distance.code.copy.tooltip:
Copies your curve, walls, materials and effects as one line of text.
Send it to a friend, or paste it on a server with /vcd preset import.
gui.vc-audio-distance.code.invalid: ✕ No profile code in the clipboard
gui.vc-audio-distance.code.paste.tooltip:
Takes the curve, walls, materials and effects from a profile code in the clipboard.
Cancel undoes it.
gui.vc-audio-distance.colors.tooltip: Colors that stay apart with red-green color blindness: blue for talking, purple for whispers, orange for walls. Radar marks also differ in shape.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.corners.no: No voice comes round a corner right now
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.corners.to: A voice behind a wall also comes round it through a doorway or window: the clearer that way, the more of the voice comes from there. The sharper the bend and the longer the way round, the duller and quieter it is. The direction glides as you walk past a doorway.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.hint: The echo comes from the space around you and around the speaker; water and rain from where you both are.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.no_world: Join a world to see your surroundings.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.reverb.str: How loud the echo is compared to the voice.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.reverb.too: Voices echo by the place: a stone room rings briefly, a cave or hall long, a wooden house briefly and warmly; a forest, a field or a wool room stay dry. Near cliffs under the open sky the voice comes back once more. The echo also comes from where the speaker is, so a voice from a cave echoes even if you are outside. Close voices stay clear, far ones sound like the room.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.fore: Forest: the leaves swallow the echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.dead: Soft room: wool and hay swallow the echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.semi: Half-open place: a light short echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.smal: Small room: a short ringing echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.wood: Wooden room: a short warm echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.tunn: Tunnel: a short echo along it
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.larg: Cave or big hall: a long rolling echo
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.space.cany: Cliffs around: they send the voice back
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.room.detai: Echo lasts %s s, walls about %s bl. away
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.room.repea: The voice comes back after %s s
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.sound_phys: It already adds echo and underwater sound to voices, so ours stay off. Rain still works.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.water.tool: When your head or the speaker's is under water, voices become dull and quiet.
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.water.unde: Your head is under water: every voice is dull and quiet
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.ra: Rain: far voices are harder to hear
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.th: Thunderstorm: far voices are much harder to hear
gui.vc-audio-distance.effects.weather.to: Under the open sky, rain makes far voices quieter and a thunderstorm even more. Close voices stay clear.
gui.vc-audio-distance.falloff.tooltip:
How strongly the voice fades with distance.
100% = normal, 0% = same volume everywhere in range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.floor.tooltip:
The curve ends at this volume at the edge of the range: the whole fade is fitted to it.
Scaled by each player's own volume, so muted players stay muted.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.background.too: How visible the HUD's background is. 0% leaves only the text.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.compact.toolti: One line for everyone talking (the closest voice and how many more) instead of a line per voice.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.corner.tooltip: Which corner of the screen the voice HUD sits in.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.group.isolated: Group: %s (isolated) — only the group hears you
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.group.open: Group: %s (open) — they hear you anywhere, and players nearby too
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.mode.tooltip: A small panel on the screen: who is talking nearby, how far and from where, and while you talk how many players hear you. "While talking" shows it only when someone speaks. There is also a key for it in Controls.
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.nobody_whisper: Nobody is close enough for a whisper
gui.vc-audio-distance.hud.scale.tooltip: Size of the voice HUD on the screen.
gui.vc-audio-distance.inspect.speaker: %s · %s bl. · %s
gui.vc-audio-distance.listen.tooltip: Plays a voice walking away from you along this curve, so you hear how it fades.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.door.tool: Doors and trapdoors (only when the ray hits the door itself).
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.earth.too:
Dirt, grass, sand, gravel, clay, mud, snow:
everything you dig with a shovel.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.ice.toolt: Ice, packed ice and blue ice.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.leaves.to: Leaves let most of the sound through.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.liquid.to: Every block of liquid between you and the speaker.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.metal.too: Blocks of iron, gold, copper and netherite, anvils.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.other.too:
Every solid block not listed here:
bedrock, blocks from other mods and so on.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.soft.tool:
Hay, sponge, moss, sculk, dried kelp –
soft blocks that swallow sound.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.stone.too:
Stone, bricks, concrete, terracotta, ores:
everything you mine with a pickaxe.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.thin.tool: Fences, gates, iron bars – mostly open.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.wood.tool:
Logs, planks and wooden blocks:
everything you chop with an axe.
gui.vc-audio-distance.material.wool.tool: Wool and carpets – the best sound insulation.
gui.vc-audio-distance.materials.hint: How much one block muffles, compared to stone (100%).
gui.vc-audio-distance.materials.hint_oth: Blocks that are not listed count as "Other blocks".
Most of the loudness is gone soon after the full-volume distance,
then voices fade to silence at the edge. Tense and quiet.
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.inverse.tool:
How sound behaves in the open: loudness drops quickly at first,
then slowly, and fades out over the last quarter of the range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.label: Curve: %s
gui.vc-audio-distance.model.linear.toolt:
Simple Voice Chat's own curve: full volume up to the
full-volume distance, then a straight fade to silence.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.col.name: Player
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.empty: Nobody is within voice range right now.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.empty_hint: Players within earshot show up here: who is talking, how loud, and through which walls.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.no_world: Join a world to see who is nearby.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.off_by_ser: The server turned off the monitor
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.server.non: Server: no addon (walls are muffled only on your side)
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.states_unk: Who has no voice chat or turned the sound off shows with Simple Voice Chat 2.6.1+ or the addon on the server.
gui.vc-audio-distance.monitor.view.toolt: List: every player with distance, loudness and walls. Radar: a map seen from above, you in the middle looking up; the rings are the voice and whisper range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.atmospheric:
Only people right next to you (about 7 blocks) are loud,
voices fade fast and walls muffle strongly. For horror and stealth maps.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.default.too:
Exactly what Simple Voice Chat does on its own:
full volume up to half the range, then a straight fade. No wall muffling.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.high_audibi:
Everyone stays understandable: full volume up to about 24 blocks,
gentle falloff, 25% at the edge, no wall muffling. Good for events.
gui.vc-audio-distance.preset.realistic.t:
Natural 1/r falloff: full volume up to about 12 blocks,
a quiet floor at the edge and walls that muffle voices.
gui.vc-audio-distance.reference.tooltip:
Up to this distance voices play at full volume,
then they start to fade. Simple Voice Chat uses half the range.
gui.vc-audio-distance.reset.tooltip:
Restore the defaults: Simple Voice Chat's own curve with wall muffling at 60%.
Cancel still brings back what you had.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.apply.toolt:
This server suggests its own sound profile.
Apply copies it into your settings; you can still change or cancel it.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.dead.toolti: Dead players are not heard until they respawn.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.enforced.fr: Server profile in use · this tab is yours
Dead players are not heard by their Simple Voice Chat group either, until they respawn.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.group.open_: Zone range, sneaking and the megaphone also work for the nearby voice of players in open groups.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.group.spect: Spectators in a group are heard only by the spectators in it.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.group.zones: An isolated zone also cuts group voices between the players inside and outside it.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.hint: Changes are saved on the server right away. More: /vcd help
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.locked.tool: While the server's profile is enforced, players cannot change these parts; the rest stays their own.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.megaphone.t: A goat horn in hand makes the voice carry further (/vcd rule megaphone for another item).
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.monitor.too: Off: players see no monitor, no radar and no nearby players in the HUD, so nobody sees others through walls.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.preset.tool: The server's sound. "Own" uses the profile values from the settings file.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.profile.too: How the server's profile reaches players with the addon: off, suggested, or enforced while they play here.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.require.too: What happens to players with Simple Voice Chat but without this addon: nothing, one message, a message every join, or a kick.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.server_wall: The server muffles walls for players who have plain Simple Voice Chat.
Spectators are heard only by other spectators.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.walls.toolt: How strongly walls muffle voices, for everyone.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.create: A 17×17×17 box around you. Pick it below to set it up; /vcd zone for exact corners.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.echo.t: An echo everywhere in the zone (a cathedral), none, or measured as usual.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zone.isolat: Voices neither leave nor enter the zone.
How far voices carry in this zone: ×2 for a stage, ×0.4 for a library.
Wall strength for players in this zone.
gui.vc-audio-distance.server.zones.none: No zones yet: make one with the button on the right, or /vcd zone.
gui.vc-audio-distance.status.sound_physi: It already muffles voices through walls, so ours stays off.
gui.vc-audio-distance.status.unavailable: Wall muffling is not available in this build
Use the Fabric version for walls, the monitor and this screen.
gui.vc-audio-distance.strength.tooltip:
How much walls affect voices.
60% ≈ one stone wall: −8 dB, muffled above ~2.5 kHz.
gui.vc-audio-distance.summary.flat: Same volume everywhere up to %s bl.
gui.vc-audio-distance.title: Voice Physics
gui.vc-audio-distance.walls.hint: Sound bends around edges: a half-open doorway muffles less than a wall.
gui.vc-audio-distance.walls.preview_off: Wall muffling is off – preview of what it would do
gui.vc-audio-distance.walls.toggle.toolt:
Voices behind walls, doors and floors become quieter and muffled,
depending on what is in between.
gui.vc-audio-distance.whisper.tooltip:
Multiplies the falloff while someone whispers.
×1.00 = like normal speech, higher = whispers fade faster.
key.vc-audio-distance.toggle_hud: Voice HUD: off / while talking / always
message.vc-audio-distance.button.tooltip: Voice distance, walls, echo, the voice HUD and the monitor.
message.vc-audio-distance.server_profile: [Voice Physics] This server uses its own sound profile while you play here. Your own settings return when you leave.
[Voice Physics] This server suggests a sound profile. Open the voice chat settings (V) → "Voice Physics…" to apply it.
message.vc-audio-distance.welcome.button: [Voice Physics] Voices now fade with distance and are muffled by walls. To tune it: voice chat settings (V) → "Voice Physics…".
message.vc-audio-distance.welcome.key: [Voice Physics] Voices now fade with distance and are muffled by walls. Press %s to tune it.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.vc-audio-: Shapes how Simple Voice Chat voices fade with distance and muffles them through walls. Client: live curve, wall preview, monitor. Server (optional): walls for players without the addon and a shared sound profile.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.vc-audio-dist: Voice distance curves and wall muffling for Simple Voice Chat.
